title: Quick Check-In
subtitle: Before moving on, please answer a few questions about how you felt during the negotiation.

questions.text: I feel confident in my ability to negotiate effectively.
I believe I could handle a similar negotiation successfully.
I have a clear understanding of what I did well in this negotiation.
I understand what I should do differently next time.
I understand why I got the outcome I did.

timing_note: Fires immediately after Round 2 ends, BEFORE S5. Identical questions to S2 — the S4 − S2 delta on each subscale is the primary self-report dependent variable.
note: ⚠️ Intentionally identical to S2. Do not change questions independently — both must stay in sync.
